scope: Actual published 1.5.0 to candidate 1.5.1 on WordPress 5.4.2, WooCommerce 3.0.0 and Polylang 2.7.4. Four native classic guest variable purchases via offline cheque, custom Large selection, legacy padded references, variation restricted coupon, selected and sibling stocks. No global attributes, wildcard, parent managed stock, backorders, shipping, refunds, block or HPOS proof.
